consequence.statement: The new Operation CRD is purely additive. If you manage CRDs separately from the release, install or update them before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: If you manage CRDs separately from the release, install or update them (including operations.ops.crossplane.io) before upgrading.

original.statement: The target release adds a new CRD, operations.ops.crossplane.io, which serves kind Operation at ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1.

decision.reason: [ev-9b2aa10ff338] shows that ops.crossplane.io_operations.yaml exists in the v2.0.0 CRD set. It is absent from the v1.20.1 set ([ev-95c4d9181c78] … [ev-dfd597f842c9]), so the Operation CRD is purely additive. Nothing in the evidence says that existing resources, settings or workloads fail, are rejected or stop being honoured. The canonical validator confirmed added/none. "none" with low severity and the stated advice about separately managed CRDs is supported, so it stays informational.
